## Downloads
| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows (x86_64) | `wled-scanner-windows-x86_64.exe` – no installation needed |
| Linux (x86_64) | `wled-scanner-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` – binary, `.desktop` file and icon |
| macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel) | `wled-scanner-macos-universal.zip` – `WLED Scanner.app` |

## Notes
- WLED only broadcasts if **Config → WiFi Setup / Sync Interfaces → Discover nodes** is enabled. Your firewall must allow incoming UDP on port 65506. On Windows, allow the app in the firewall prompt on first start.
- The macOS app is not signed. On first start, right-click it and choose **Open**.
- Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the `.exe` is not signed. Choose **More info → Run anyway**.
